dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly linear and symmetrical; no significant asymmetrical structural bulges or indentations are visible along the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium slate-grey tone; median pixel intensity is consistent with a sub-adult or transitional color phase, filtering out subtle surface glare.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse mottling across the dorsal plane with subtle, low-frequency variations in grey-scale intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between localized pigmented variations and the primary grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One prominent dark circular void at the anterior pole (blowhole) and a distinct, thin, longitudinal white mark on the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible narrow, longitudinal white linear scar or rake mark located on the posterior third of the dorsal midline.
